decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core everyday item made with established recipes and production, so it keeps meeting aspirations at low cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The premium raisin stollen is the flagship and has repeatedly won gold medals, so it clearly exceeds aspirations and dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range and uses existing resources, and there is no sign of a shortfall that would justify cutting it.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant with some risk of range pruning, but it runs on the existing line and slack still lets the firm carry it.
The ancient grain bread was promoted as the newest master piece and its results are still uncertain, so the firm would give it more time instead of cutting it early.
